## `neuro.int8Array.subarray`

Instance method on `Int8Array.prototype`.

> Gets a new Int8Array view of the ArrayBuffer store for this array, referencing the elements
> at begin, inclusive, up to end, exclusive.

## Signatures

```ts
subarray(input: { int8Array: <receiver>; begin?: number; end?: number; prompt?: string }): Promise<Int8Array>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Int8Array.prototype.subarray` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
